channel.title: Covering Katy News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Covering Katy News (coveringkaty.com)

item.title: School of Rock Fulshear Announces Grand Opening March 2 and Free Community Open House Feb. 28
item.description: Fort Bend County is turning up the volume. School of Rock Fulshear will open its doors Monday, March 2, bringing performance-based music education to the growing Fulshear community and nearby neighborhoods. \

item.title: Houston Texans to Build New Headquarters and Practice Facility in Bridgeland near Katy
item.description: Harris County commissioners approved a memorandum of understanding Wednesday to pursue a public-private partnership with the Houston Texans and Howard Hughes Holdings that would create a mixed-use sports and entertainment destination in Bridgeland.

item.title: Tamara McFarlane Caught Being Untruthful About Endorsement
item.description: Bend County Clerk Candidate Tamara McFarlane has been posting that she's been endorsed by Steve Toth, a Republican State Representative from the Woodlands, but Toth says he's not endorsing anyone.

item.title: Eighth annual Katy Taste Fest returns Feb. 28 with new farmers market
item.description: The eighth annual Katy Taste Fest will return to Typhoon Texas on Saturday, Feb. 28, featuring tastings from more than 30 area restaurants, live cooking demonstrations and a new farmers market.

item.title: Toth's conflicting messages on McFarlane endorsement raise questions as early voting is set to begin
item.description: It appears that state Rep. Steve Toth (R-The Woodlands) may be telling people what they want to hear when it comes to whether he is endorsing Tamara McFarlane, who is running a racially charged primary campaign for Fort Bend County clerk.

item.title: Cinco Ranch HOA asks residents to bury visible utility lines by March 1
item.description: The Cinco Ranch Homeowners Association is asking residents to have all visible utility lines on their properties buried by March 1, 2026, as part of ongoing efforts to maintain the safety and appearance of the community.

item.title: Katy Rodeo Parade closes annual Katy ISD FFA Livestock Show and Rodeo
item.description: The Katy Rodeo Parade took place Saturday marking the end of the annual Katy ISD FFA Livestock Show and Rodeo.

item.title: Olive Garden, Whataburger, Chase Bank Coming to Texas Heritage Marketplace Near Katy
item.description: Olive Garden, Whataburger and Chase Bank have finalized ground leases for the Texas Heritage Marketplace, a $400 million regional development under construction in Waller County near Katy.

item.title: Katy and Richmond Child Predator Sentenced to 25 Years for Sexual Abuse of Young Child
item.description: A Dominican immigrant who sexually abused a child in the Katy and Richmond areas has been sentenced to 25 years in prison. Jason Alfred Sanderson, 39, pleaded guilty Feb. 2 to continuous sexual abuse of a young child.

item.title: Early Voting Times and Locations for Katy's three counties
item.description: Early voting in Texas starts today, Feb. 17, 2027 and runs through Feb 27. The Katy area is spread across Fort Bend, Harris and Waller Counties. The times and locations for each county's early voting is located below.
